what: Short thick ticks (1.18% of window width × 2px) sit on the four corners of cells divided by 1px lines. When you hover anywhere on a cell, the ticks lengthen 2.5× with the corner as the axis over .35s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1), and return on release. It’s a reaction that signals a cell on the line grid is one block.

options.look: light: Tick marks in the background color (dark panel, over photo)
options.--fx-grow: Multiplier on hover, default 2.5 — 1 gives decorative ticks that don’t grow
options.--fx-overlap: Distance ticks stick out of the cell, default 0 (the original overlapping cell is .0694vw)
options.[data-fx-part=tick]: If you set four ticks directly (data-key=tl|tr|br|bl) used as is, if absent, the part adds it

from.where: All pages .pr-bl — Hero cell, News widget, number marquee cell, grid text cell, location box (original BorderLines: .border-line 1.1806vw×2px, .is-hovered scaleX(2.5) .35s var(--ease-out-cubic))
